pets.name: One-Eyed Rusty Slug
pets.description: Leaves a sticky snail trail everywhere it crawls. Barely moves, occasionally nibbles on dirt.

pets.name: Scabby Stray Alley Cat
pets.description: Feral, missing half its tail, and permanently smells like old fish garbage. Will hiss if looked at.

pets.name: Dented Clockwork Rat
pets.description: A mechanical wind-up toy rat whose spring snaps every three steps. Emits loud grinding noises.

pets.name: Scout Farm Puppy
pets.description: An energetic hound puppy that loves chasing butterflies and chewing on bandit boots.

pets.name: Forest Tree Owl
pets.description: A wise little barn owl that hoots mournfully at dusk and spots hidden shiny pebbles.

pets.name: Meadow Badger
pets.description: Tenacious and stubborn. Digs trenches in the soil and refuses to let go of enemy ankles.

pets.name: Swift Ironbeak Hawk
pets.description: Trained mountain hawk with razor-sharp talons and keen eyesight across vast valleys.

pets.name: Silverfang Wolf
pets.description: A loyal pack hunter with lustrous silver fur and an intimidating hunting howl.

pets.name: Spark Sprite
pets.description: A floating orb of crackling static electricity that illuminates dark dungeons.

pets.name: Mystic Crystal Fox
pets.description: Endowed with nine ethereal tails and crystalline amethyst shards embedded in its fur.

pets.name: Armored Iron Grizzly
pets.description: A massive bear fitted with dwarven steel shoulder plates. Swipes with earth-shattering force.

pets.name: Shadow Stalker Panther
pets.description: Melts seamlessly into shadows, striking enemies from blind spots with venomous grace.

pets.name: Thunder Gryphon Hatchling
pets.description: Majestic beast combining lion and eagle traits, crackling with continuous summer lightning.

pets.name: Abyssal Drake Whelp
pets.description: A juvenile dragon born from sub-oceanic trenches. Breathes scalding dark flames.

pets.name: Phoenix Flame Chick
pets.description: Radiates eternal warmth. Even when defeated in combat, its embers rekindle instantly.

pets.name: Celestial Sun Lion
pets.description: A legendary guardian beast blessed by solar deities, radiating blinding golden light and unmatched valor.

pets.name: Starlight Unicorn Prime
pets.description: Pure ethereal manifestation of celestial grace. Heals allies and purifies all dark curses instantly.

pets.name: Void Serpent Leviathan
pets.description: An ancient cosmic serpent whose coils span across starry nebulae. Swallows enemy magic whole.

pets.name: Astral Phoenix
pets.description: A magnificent immortal bird of elemental fire. Incinerates legions of foes with a single flutter of its wings.

pets.name: Dragon Emperor
pets.description: An ancient dragon lord whose armored scales absorb elemental spells.

pets.name: Genesis Kirin
pets.description: The primordial divine beast of creation and eternity, granting absolute protection.
